records.title: Gold Standard Project Design Elements
records.use: Use the relevant elements—authenticity, learner voice/choice, reflection, critique/revision and public product—as design options, not a universal checklist imposed on every project class.
records.access_note: Public framework page; no full-text copying.
records.design_limit: Public product is one of the framework's elements; ATHENA does not impose public sharing on personal-use or intrinsic projects where it is not part of the class purpose or safe/desired.

records.title: Core Practices for Project-Based Learning
records.use: Supports higher-order thinking, alignment to disciplinary ideas, iteration, formative feedback and reflection/revision.

records.title: Project-Based Learning
records.publisher: Virginia Tech Center for Excellence in Teaching and Learning
records.use: Supports authentic questions, application of disciplinary knowledge, student choice, feedback, revision, audience and right-sized scope.

records.title: Framework for High Quality Project Based Learning
records.use: Reference for intellectual challenge, authenticity, collaboration, project management and reflection.

records.title: A Practical Guide to Open Portfolios
records.use: Supports process evidence, learner-centred making and portfolios that show growth and application; public sharing is not treated as mandatory.
records.license_note: The PDF states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Link to it and attribute; do not copy/adapt it into ATHENA content unless the license conditions are satisfied. Non-commercial restriction is relevant.

records.title: Assessing learning in technology-rich maker activities: A systematic review of empirical research
records.use: Caution: maker assessment should combine artefact evidence with other methods; psychometric evidence was limited in reviewed studies.
records.evidence_caution: The review abstract reports that only 15% of the reviewed studies provided psychometric evidence for reliability and validity of maker assessments; do not assume project rubrics are validated.

records.title: Fostering Students' Creativity and Critical Thinking
records.use: Supports situated inquiry and creation of artefacts while emphasising process and reflection.

limitations: The four opened pages were inspected for identity and relevant scope; this is not a systematic review of all underlying research, and does not validate ATHENA's project bank. The MakerEd guide is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; use a link and attribution rather than copying/adapting content unless its conditions are satisfied. Design-method sources do not replace subject-specific resource discovery for each project's target objectives.
